razonamiento: Merged visual and spoken elements into a single architecture graph. b4 and b5 represent the same SQS rendering instruction queue (one visual text label, one visual icon) and are merged into node 4. Container c0 ('EC2 AUTO SCALING') represents both the EC2 Spot rendering instances (node 6) and the Auto Scaling group (node 7); lines connected to c0 were mapped according to narration (workload/metrics to EC2, scaling interactions to AutoScaling). Drawn line directions were preserved per Rule 4, including b3->b6, c0->b10, and b10->b11. The spoken flow of the scaling Lambda consuming CloudWatch metrics was included as a spoken edge (9->11). The spot termination Lambda described in speech was omitted as a separate node because the whiteboard drew CloudWatch Events directly targeting the EC2 instances (12->6).
nombre: Video Rendering as a Service (RaaS) on EC2 Spot Instances
